name: It's Raining Bricks
tagline: Bricks rain down from the night sky: swipe, spin and stack them into lines. No ads, with cheats if you're into that.
requires: Android 13 or newer. Plays in portrait.
note: Had the earlier version of this game? It has a new name now, so it installs next to the old one: install this, then uninstall the old one.
